sources.description: Framed photographic advisor card with actual exterior transparency; retain opaque photo/frame/note and original soft exterior shadow. Original PER generic1 small card: slanted dark brown service cap with small gold badge, short dark side hair and brows, young serious near-frontal face angled slightly viewer-right, dark brown military outerwear with khaki/brown high scarf/collar. Fine upper-lip pixels uncertain, no full beard visibly established. Photo/frame/note opaque, soft exterior alpha only.

Framed photographic advisor card with actual exterior transparency; retain opaque photo/frame/note and original soft exterior shadow. Original PER generic2 small card: brown cylindrical service cap with small gold badge/band, dark brows and hair mostly hidden, slightly raised head angled modestly viewer-left, brown/khaki coat with pale khaki high scarf/neckwear. Fine upper-lip detail uncertain. Preserve cap silhouette, angle and collar.

Framed photographic advisor card with actual exterior transparency; retain opaque photo/frame/note and original soft exterior shadow. Original PER military1 small card: tall brown peaked cap with dark shiny visor and small gold/red badge, dark side hair and brows, serious head in strong viewer-left angle, dark uniform with red/gold patterned high collar. Preserve actual strong angle and cap shape; fine moustache detail uncertain. Native viewer's white exterior display artefacts do not appear on composited source mattes: actual photo/frame/note are opaque with soft exterior alpha only.

Framed photographic advisor card with actual exterior transparency; retain opaque photo/frame/note and original soft exterior shadow. Original SOV marine infantry card: dark round sailor cap with gold unreadable hatband marks, short grey/dark side hair and brows, visible small grey moustache, serious near-frontal face, navy coat with blue high folded collar/neckwear and gold buttons. Preserve cap shape, moustache, blue collar, source pose and unreadable hatband marks.
